authorProcess.role: Case author AI only; not reviewer or implementer
authorProcess.excludedSources: No implementation, prior datasets/results, sibling reviewer files or parent task history inspected. Only the supplied task instructions and named policy informed the cases.
authorProcess.authorship: 40 original fictional English software support requests composed in this author session, five per stratum. No model APIs called; no branches created.
authorProcess.limits: AI authorship does not prove training-data exclusion or supply human adjudication. Author labels are proposals for subsequent independent AI review.
authorProcess.validation: 40 sequential unique IDs; subject and body bounds; five per stratum; every review route null.
authorProcess.toolNote: An initial Python process failed before script execution because its standard library was unavailable. The cases were then saved and validated using Node.

review.limitations: Separate AI contexts, not human adjudication. Reviewer knew assigned strata but labelled actual content. Agreement is not truth; shared blind spots and conceptual overlap remain possible. Routing labels do not independently establish evidence relevance. Set is now seen.

armDefinitions.guarded: rules guarded v7; no extra model calls
